tasks.title: Model closed option domain
tasks.description: Implement closed Kotlin/TypeScript schema, presentation, selection and cause types plus single wire translators and independent flow steps.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Unknown wire values fail closed
AC-2: No profile/option magic strings reach views or stores
GATE: domain tests pass

tasks.title: Migrate option persistence safely
tasks.description: Add axes, values, assignments, deferred complete vectors, validation guard, schema presence/revision and mandatory external compatibility interlock.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Clean/upgrade preserve every legal legacy product
AC-2: Absent creates no empty vector
AC-3: previous artifact is denied before traffic
GATE: PostgreSQL 16 migration tests pass

tasks.title: Implement option CAS and writer protocol
tasks.description: Implement Replace/Clear and closed variant operations under product-to-variant locks while preserving authorized Absent legacy behavior.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: stale or invalid commands change no data, audit or CSRF
AC-2: only ADMIN activates assignments for Valid schema
AC-3: Absent price/stock/active regression passes
GATE: concurrency tests pass

tasks.title: Project fail-closed option wire
tasks.description: Expose ABSENT/VALID/UNKNOWN with closed cause and bounded bulk axes/assignment reads without N+1.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: only Absent enables generic fallback
AC-2: corrupt/duplicate data blocks purchase
GATE: projection and query-count tests pass

tasks.title: Add public and admin catalog search
tasks.description: Wire normalized literal search through both controllers, services, readers and Angular stores for name, case-insensitive SKU and nullable category.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: items and count share authorization/predicate
AC-2: public excludes inactive while admin keeps its authorized visibility
GATE: two-page search tests pass

tasks.title: Build deterministic selection engine
tasks.description: Resolve partial/complete/unavailable/unknown combinations, quantity semantics and durable purchase-intent tombstones with generation fences.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: partial vectors never autocomplete
AC-2: reload/late response cannot revive tombstoned SKU
AC-3: explicit action creates a new flowId
GATE: engine tests pass

tasks.title: Render accessible PDP option controls
tasks.description: Build Select and Swatch axes with visible labels, keyboard semantics, disabled reasons and one authoritative purchase selection.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: swatches never rely on color alone
AC-2: price/stock/SKU/favorite/submit never reuse stale selection
GATE: component and Axe tests pass

tasks.title: Build ADMIN option editor
tasks.description: Build ordered axis/value/assignment editor, preview, Clear/Replace commands and explicit diff/reapply after 409.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: 409 preserves draft without automatic overwrite
AC-2: OPERATOR is read-only
AC-3: invalid labels/codes/combinations are explained
GATE: admin component tests pass

tasks.title: Prove backend integrity and resource bounds
tasks.description: Run clean/upgrade, FK ownership, swaps, 400/404/409, role/origin/CSRF, 1,000 variants and 4,000 assignment scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: database invariants survive concurrency
AC-2: limits apply before materialization
GATE: backend suite and measured budget pass

tasks.title: Prove buyer and admin browser journeys
tasks.description: Exercise simple hardware, clothing Select/Swatch, non-cartesian partials, quantity, intent reload, search and admin conflict at 390/768/1440.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: buyer and admin acceptance matrix passes
AC-2: no overflow or critical Axe violation
GATE: real-browser suite passes

tasks.title: Run exact-head code and product review

tasks.title: Run exact-head performance review

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: measured budgets have evidence
GATE: performance review approves

tasks.title: Run exact-head security review
tasks.description: Review role/capability/CSRF, parser bounds, prototype safety, fail-closed wire, interlock and intent replay defenses.

GATE: security review approves
